steps.help: Step 1 of 9: The Assignments page shows all current and past assignments. You can see each assignment's period name, template, submission status, and public URL status.
Step 2 of 9: Each assignment row shows the period name, template name, and submission progress. Use this to identify which assignments need attention.
Step 3 of 9: View which countries have submitted, which are in progress, and which are overdue. This helps you identify where follow-up is needed.
Step 1 of 9: Click the edit icon (pencil) next to the assignment you want to modify. This opens the assignment edit form.
Step 2 of 9: You can update the template, period name, and deadline. Changes to the deadline will apply to all countries in the assignment.
Step 3 of 9: If you need to add more countries to an existing assignment, use the "Add Countries" section. Select countries and click "Add" to include them.
Step 4 of 9: Click "Save Changes" to apply your updates. Focal points will be notified if new countries are added.
Step 1 of 9: Click the delete icon (trash) next to the assignment you want to remove. You'll be asked to confirm.
Step 2 of 9: Confirm that you want to delete the assignment. This will remove the assignment and all associated country statuses and data. This action cannot be undone.
